entities.summary: Lev Aleksandrovich Zilber was a Soviet micro-biologist whose work focused on virology and immunology. He was an academician of the USSR Academy of Medical Sciences and the founder of the Soviet school of virology. His younger brother was the famous writer Veniamin Kaverin.
